verdict.rationale: Cognee documents explicit add/search/enrich/delete memory primitives (.remember, .recall, .improve, .forget) exposed via API, CLI, and an official MCP server so agents like Claude/Cursor/Cline can invoke them as tools mid-conversation, plus session-scoped short-term memory for in-conversation caching. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that an agent autonomously chains these calls mid-session, and no explicit 'update' primitive distinct from enrich/forget/re-remember.
